ai.seo_question: What does it mean that God is 'Basir' (All-Seeing/Knowing) in Surah Taa-Haa?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a reassurance to the Prophet Muhammad, affirming that God’s omniscience encompasses both the visible actions and hidden intentions of humanity, thereby validating the prophetic mission. It highlights the attribute of *Basirah* (all-seeing) not merely as passive observation but as an active, comprehensive awareness that guides divine judgment and mercy.
